derivation: from G4012 (περί) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);
def: to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze

occurrences.text: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
